rows.grounds: past participle kṣālita joined with aṅghri in nominative singular masculine
compound of snāna and maṇḍapa in accusative singular neuter

items.question: What preparatory bodily purification must the officiant complete before entering the bath pavilion?
items.inference: the officiant enters the bath pavilion only after washing the feet and sipping water
uncertainties: whether samācamya implies ritual sipping or ordinary drinking
whether kṣālitāṅghriḥ describes the officiant or an attendant
items.plain_english: Having washed his feet and sipped water, he enters the bath pavilion.
